findings.title: Security fix has no regression test
findings.body: This PR disables SQL expressions by returning an error before query parsing and by stubbing the SQL DB methods. No test files are changed in this PR, so there is no automated verification that a QueryTypeSQL query is rejected or that NewSQLCommand/TablesList never executes SQL. Given this is a critical security fix, a regression test should be added asserting the error path and that the SQL execution path remains unreachable.

findings.title: enableSqlExpressions always returns false
findings.body: The helper computes enabled := !h.features.IsEnabledGlobally(featuremgmt.FlagSqlExpressions) and then returns false in both branches, making the feature toggle ineffective and leaving dead code. Operators who enable the sqlExpressions feature flag will still get 'sqlExpressions is not implemented'. If unconditional disable is intended, the code should return false directly with a comment; otherwise it should honor the toggle so the documented flag has the expected effect.
